Resolves #5219

Implements WAI-ARIA Date Picker Dialog and Grid semantics across `Neo.form.field.Date`, `Neo.form.field.trigger.Date`, `Neo.component.DateSelector`, and `Neo.selection.DateSelectorModel` (`aria-haspopup="dialog"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, non-modal `role="dialog"` container delegating opening focus to the active/selected day `gridcell`, keyboard-operable `DateTrigger` and month navigation `role="button"` controls, header `aria-live="polite"`, and calendar `grid` / `row` / `columnheader` / `gridcell` semantics with `aria-label` weekday names, roving `tabIndex`, `aria-current="date"`, `aria-disabled`, and `aria-selected`).

Evidence: L2 (Playwright real-browser component suite in `test/playwright/component/form/field/Date.spec.mjs` + unit suite in `test/playwright/unit/form/field/DateAria.spec.mjs`) → L2 required (real-browser non-modal dialog focus lifecycle, `Tab`/`Shift+Tab` traversal, `Enter`/`Space` button activation, and accessibility-tree `columnheader` accessible names alongside VDOM/state assertions).

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline pre-commit checks ran.

## AC Evidence
- AC 1: Input, Trigger & Non-Modal Dialog Contract (`aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, non-modal `role="dialog"`, opening focus on active day `gridcell`, `DateTrigger` `tabIndex: 0` & `Enter`/`Space` activation) — `test/playwright/component/form/field/Date.spec.mjs` (`exposes a non-modal dialog picker, focuses the selected day gridcell on open, and supports Tab/Shift+Tab traversal and Escape dismissal`, `supports keyboard focus and Enter/Space activation on DateTrigger and DateSelector month navigation buttons`) and `test/playwright/unit/form/field/DateAria.spec.mjs` (`DateField input, trigger, and floating picker expose non-modal WAI-ARIA dialog attributes, trigger keyboard activation, and sync aria-expanded`)
- AC 2: Calendar Header, Month Navigation Buttons & Live Region (`.neo-prev-button` / `.neo-next-button` `role="button"`, `tabIndex: 0`, `Enter`/`Space` activation preserving focus, `DomEvents` Space scroll suppression, `aria-live="polite"`) — `test/playwright/component/form/field/Date.spec.mjs` (`supports keyboard focus and Enter/Space activation on DateTrigger and DateSelector month navigation buttons`) and `test/playwright/unit/form/field/DateAria.spec.mjs` (`DateSelector renders WAI-ARIA grid, columnheader aria-label, roving gridcell tabIndex, nav button keyboard handlers, and selection states`)
- AC 3: Calendar Grid, Weekday Column Headers & Roving `gridcell` States (`role="grid"`, `role="columnheader"` localized `aria-label` accessible names across `dayNameFormat` and `locale`, `role="gridcell"`, roving `tabIndex`, `aria-selected`, `aria-current="date"`, `aria-disabled`) — `test/playwright/component/form/field/Date.spec.mjs` (`exposes full localized weekday names in the browser accessibility tree for columnheader cells across dayNameFormat and locale changes`) and `test/playwright/unit/form/field/DateAria.spec.mjs` (`DateSelector renders WAI-ARIA grid, columnheader aria-label, roving gridcell tabIndex, nav button keyboard handlers, and selection states`)

## Deltas from ticket
- `DateField#createPicker` uses non-modal `role="dialog"` (without `aria-modal="true"`) to match `Picker`'s outside-pointer and `focusLeave` dismissal contract rather than claiming a focus trap it does not implement.

## Test Evidence
All coverage runs in CI (`test/playwright/unit/form/field/DateAria.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/component/form/field/Date.spec.mjs`).

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] None required.
